title: Daisy Deer's High Jump
description: Daisy feels nervous about stepping over a fallen tree branch, but learns that taking small steps leads to big courage.

scenes.narration: Daisy Deer loved exploring the soft mossy trails of the enchanted wood with her gentle forest family.
scenes.visual: A young fawn walking along a soft mossy path inside a sunny forest

scenes.narration: One sunny morning, a thick mossy log lay right across the path, blocking Daisy's way to the clover meadow.
scenes.visual: A small deer standing in front of a mossy fallen tree trunk

scenes.narration: Daisy paused and wobbled slightly. To her small legs, the log looked as high as a big mountain wall.
scenes.visual: A little fawn looking up doubtfully at a wooden log across the path

scenes.narration: Her mama walked over gently, nuzzling Daisy's ear softly. She showed her how to step one tiny hoof over at a time.
scenes.visual: A mother deer standing next to her fawn offering encouragement on a trail

scenes.narration: Daisy took a calm, quiet breath. She lifted her left hoof, then her right, stepping gracefully right over the log.
scenes.visual: A tiny fawn stepping carefully over a small fallen branch in a wood

scenes.narration: She pranced happily into the sunny meadow. Daisy learned that big obstacles become easy when you take them one small step at a time.
scenes.visual: A fawn bounding happily across a sunlit meadow full of butterflies

scenes.narration: Rest well tonight knowing you are braver than you think. Follow along for more heartwarming bedtime stories.
scenes.visual: A peaceful sunset over a quiet grassy meadow with distant blue hills

character_reference: A small fawn with warm chestnut-brown fur, delicate white spots scattered along her back, large dark brown eyes, and tiny black hooves.
